title: Unforgettable Molten Syrian Lamb Pasta
description: A citrusy and molten Syrian dish featuring paccheri pasta, perfect for a date night, and compliant with Whole30 diet.
instructions: Press the saute button on the pressure cooker and heat the olive oil until shimmering.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the lamb shoulder pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the paccheri pasta, lemon juice, pomegranate molasses, salt, and black pepper to the pressure cooker.
Close the lid and set the valve to sealing, then press the manual button and set the cooking time to 10 minutes at high pressure.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release any remaining pressure.
Stir in the chopped parsley and serve hot.
